
---
title: "2000-2015 WHO European vs. Global WHO Estimated Malaria Cases"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
date: "2026-10-14"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(rnaturalearth)

# Read the CSV files in your project folder
global_raw <- read_csv(
  "Estimated number of malaria cases 2000-2015.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

europe_raw <- read_csv(
  "Estimated number of WHO Europe malaria cases 2000-2015.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Prepare the global data
global_cases <- global_raw %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = Location,
    year = as.integer(Period),
    cases = as.numeric(FactValueNumeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2015)

# Prepare the European data
europe_cases <- europe_raw %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = country,
    year = as.integer(year),
    cases = as.numeric(FactValueNumeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2015)

# Load country borders
world <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  mutate(
    iso3 = if_else(iso_a3 == "-99", adm0_a3, iso_a3)
  ) %>%
  select(iso3, name, geometry)

# Use the same color scale on both maps
case_palette <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#f187d0", "#c2168c", "#0c0434"),
  domain = log10(global_cases$cases + 1),
  na.color = "#d9d9d9"
)
```


```{r}
draw_malaria_map <- function(data, selected_year, europe_zoom = FALSE) {

  map_data <- world %>%
    left_join(
      data %>% filter(year == as.integer(selected_year)),
      by = "iso3"
    )

  map <- leaflet(map_data) %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~case_palette(log10(cases + 1)),
      fillOpacity = 0.85,
      color = "#ffffff",
      weight = 0.5,
      label = ~paste0(
        name, ": ",
        ifelse(
          is.na(cases),
          "No estimate in this file",
          format(round(cases), big.mark = ",")
        ),
        " estimated cases"
      ),
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        weight = 2,
        color = "#312c54",
        bringToFront = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal = case_palette,
      values = log10(global_cases$cases + 1),
      title = "Estimated cases",
      labFormat = labelFormat(
        transform = function(x) 10^x - 1,
        digits = 0,
        big.mark = ","
      ),
      na.label = "No estimate"
    )

  if (europe_zoom) {
    map <- map %>% setView(lng = 40, lat = 45, zoom = 3)
  }

  map
}
```

```{r year-selector, echo=FALSE}
selectInput(
  inputId = "year",
  label = "Choose a year:",
  choices = 2000:2015,
  selected = 2015
)
```

## Interactive malaria maps {.tabset}

### Global malaria estimates

```{r global-map, echo=FALSE}
leafletOutput("global_map", height = "600px")
```

### WHO European Region

```{r europe-map, echo=FALSE}
leafletOutput("europe_map", height = "600px")
```


```{r run-maps, echo=FALSE}
ui <- fluidPage(
  selectInput("year", "Choose a year:",
              choices = 2000:2015, selected = 2015),
  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel("Global malaria estimates",
             leafletOutput("global_map", height = "600px")),
    tabPanel("WHO European Region",
             leafletOutput("europe_map", height = "600px"))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  output$global_map <- renderLeaflet({
    draw_malaria_map(
      global_cases,
      selected_year = input$year
    )
  })

  output$europe_map <- renderLeaflet({
    draw_malaria_map(
      europe_cases,
      selected_year = input$year,
      europe_zoom = TRUE
    )
  })

}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
